{{Short description|German mathematician (1942–2016)}}
[[File:Wolf Barth.jpeg|thumb|Wolf Barth at Dortmund in 1980<br>(photo from MFO)]]
'''Wolf Paul Barth''' (20 October 1942, in [[Wernigerode]] – 30 December 2016, in [[Nuremberg]]) was a German [[mathematician]] who discovered [[Barth surface]]s and whose work on [[vector bundle]]s has been important for the [[ADHM construction]].<ref>{{cite journal | last1=Bauer | first1=Thomas | last2=Hulek | first2=Klaus | author2-link=Klaus Hulek|last3=Rams | first3=Sławomir | last4=Sarti | first4=Alessandra | author4-link= Alessandra Sarti | last5=Szemberg | first5=Tomasz | title=Wolf Barth (1942–2016) | journal=Jahresbericht der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung | volume=119 | issue=4 |year=  2017 |arxiv=1704.07446| doi=10.1365/s13291-017-0164-7 | bibcode=2017arXiv170407446B | pages=273–292 | mr=3709976| s2cid=119135970 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | last1=Atiyah | first1=Michael Francis | author1-link=Michael Atiyah | last3=Hitchin | first3=Nigel J. |author3-link=Nigel Hitchin| last2=Drinfeld | first2=Vladimir G. |author2-link=Vladimir Drinfeld| last4=Manin | first4=Yuri Ivanovich | author4-link=Yuri Ivanovich Manin | title=Construction of instantons | doi=10.1016/0375-9601(78)90141-X | bibcode=1978PhLA...65..185A | mr=598562  | year=1978 | journal=Physics Letters A | volume=65 | issue=3 | pages=185–187}}</ref> Until 2011, Barth was working in the Department of Mathematics at the [[University of Erlangen-Nuremberg]] in Germany.

Barth received a PhD degree in 1967 from the [[University of Göttingen]]. His dissertation, written under the direction of [[Reinhold Remmert]]
and [[Hans Grauert]], was entitled ''Einige Eigenschaften analytischer Mengen in kompakten komplexen Mannigfaltigkeiten'' (''Some properties of analytic sets in compact, complex manifolds'').<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=49686}}</ref>
